authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The full jalūkā article separates l-retaining jalūkā/jalaukā from section 3 *jōkkā/*jōṅkā. The selected forms have the contracted k/g stem of section 3: compare Nepali juko, Oriya juka and Bengali/Hindi jõk. Final a/o are ordinary nominal endings; voicing, aspiration and nasalization variants are retained. Responses containing separate words or unexplained -kuvā material are excluded.
